description: DJ MANNY embodies everything Chicago Footwork stands for. As an exceptional DJ, producer, dancer and a protégé of the legendary DJ RASHAD, Manny is a cornerstone of the movement. His discography is packed with classics released on Teklife, Moveltraxx, Planet Mu, Hyperdub, and more, along with iconic remixes for artists like Kelela, Paul Johnson, μ-Ziq, Big Dope P, and Kush Jones. With his new "Party All Night" EP, Manny showcases his ability to constantly reinvent his sound while keeping it dancefloor-ready, uniting ravers and footworkers alike at 160 BPM.
